name: Sofcom Systems Limited
about: Sofcom Systems Limited provides software installation, maintenance, and consultancy services in India, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. It offers information technology solutions, including IT consulting and system integration. The company also provides software development, as well as software maintenance, reengineering, and downsizing of software application services for the distribution, banking, telecommunication, and manufacturing sectors. In addition, it offers trading platforms, mobile trading applications, order management and risk management systems, broker back-office solutions, eKYC and onboarding solutions, re-KYC and compliance solutions, CRM solutions for brokers, mutual fund and wealth management platforms, analytics and reporting solutions, and API suite solutions, for stockbrokers, wealth firms, NBFCs, and fintech startups. Further, the company provides custom software development, product customization, API and integration services, migration and modernization services, support and maintenance services, and compliance workflow solutions. Sofcom Systems Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Surat, India.
